Name: Pistol Auto 9mm 1A
Notes: Standard issue side-arm of the Indian Army. Licensed copy of the Canadian Inglis 9mm pistol.

Name: Glock 17
Notes: Standard issue Special Forces pistol.

Name: SAF Carbine 1A
Notes: Indian made Sterling L2A1 SMG. To be replaced by the MSMC.

Name: SAF Carbine 2A1
Notes: Silenced Carbine. To be replaced by the MSMC.

Name: Micro-Uzi
Notes: For use by Special Forces. Micro-Uzi variant used.

Name: 1B1 INSAS
Notes: Standard issue weapon of the Indian Army. Replaced the 1A SLR. Folding 1B2 and fixed butt 1B1 variants used. Insas AR with full-auto selector lever along with the burst lever and black polymer furniture also being procured. Manufactured at Ordnance Factory Tiruchirappalli.

Name: OFB 1A1 RiflesOFB 1C Rifles
Notes: Was the standard issue rifle of the Indian army and manufactured at Ordnance Factory Tiruchirappalli. Now being replaced by the INSAS. 1C full automatic variant used by mechanised infantry battalions as a firing port weapon on the BMP-2S Sarath Infantry fighting vehicle.

Name: Ishapore 2A1 rifle
Notes: Most were phased out from service. Some retained for ceremonial purposes.

Name: AKM
Notes: AKM fixed stock and AKMS under-folding stock variants used.

Name: Arsenal Co. AR
Notes: Bulgarian produced AK-47. Imported for police and paramilitary forces, used in some quantities by Army as well. AR fixed stock and AR-F under-folding stock variants used.

Name: MPi-KM
Notes: East German produced AKM.MPi-KM-72 fixed stock and MPi-KMS-72 side-folding stock variants used.Both bakelite and wooden lower handguard variants used.

Name: Pistol Mitralieră model 1990
Notes: Romanian version of the AKM. Palmswell lower handguard versions in use.

Name: Vz. 58
Notes: Vz. 58 P fixed stock and Vz. 58 V side-folding stock variants used.

Name: IMI Tavor TAR-21
Notes: 3070 purchased for the Special Forces from Israel

Name: M4A1 Carbine
Notes: Bought under foreign military sales. For use by Indian Army Special Forces.

Name: Dragunov SVD59
Notes: Standard sniper rifle.

Name: IMI Galil 7.62 Sniper
Notes: For use by Indian Army Special Forces.

Name: Mauser SP66
Notes: Standard bolt-action sniper rifle.

Name: Denel NTW-20
Notes: Bought in small numbers.

Name: INSAS LMG
Notes: Light machine gun derivative of the INSAS assault rifle. Both fixed and folding butt variants used. Newer INSAS LMG with black polymer furniture being procured. Manufactured at Ordnance Factory Tiruchirappalli.

Name: MG 1B
Notes: Indian made Bren.Currently being withdrawn from service.

Name: MG 2A1MG 5AMG 6A
Notes: Indian made MAG 58. Also in service as the MG 5A (Co-axial) and MG 6A (Commander's gun) with some armoured vehicles.

Name: PKM
Notes: PK machine guns used as co-axial weapons in Russian produced T-90S Bhishma, T-72M Ajeya and BMP-2S Sarath and used as general purpose machine gun. Also used by Special Forces as section LMG. Manufactured at Ordnance Factory Tiruchirappalli.
